title: Fog and Broken Steel
summary: The party arrived in Millhaven under cover of a thick autumn fog. After securing rooms at the Soggy Boot, they learned from a tight-lipped barkeep known only as The Dark that bandit activity had made Swamp Road impassable. During a tense confrontation with a pair of scouts at the edge of town, Pippen's blade shattered against a brigand's shield, leaving him weaponless. The evening ended with the party regrouping at the tavern, no closer to the road — but considerably wiser about the dangers ahead.
keyEvents: Learned of bandit activity from The Dark
loose threads: Who is Commander Voss working for?
